name: LP-CC2652R7 LaunchPad
description: Multi-protocol 2.4 GHz LaunchPad: BLE 5, Zigbee, Thread and proprietary on the CC2652R7 (Cortex-M4F, 704 KB flash) with XDS110 debugger, on-board antenna and 40-pin BoosterPack headers.
notes: The board carries the CC2652R7 (704 KB flash) rather than the older CC2652R (352 KB); mcuId points at the CC2652R family entry. Includes a micro-USB cable.
TI price is from the page's structured data. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
